events_chronological: A career thief serves nine years in prison abroad while his daughter grows up without him.
The daughter moves to the west coast and takes up with a wealthy record producer.
She works out that he is laundering drug money and threatens to go to the police.
His head of security kills her and dresses it as a crash on a canyon road.
The thief is released, reads a newspaper cutting somebody has posted to him, and flies out.
He finds an acquaintance of his daughter's, who tells him the little he knows.
He goes to a warehouse to ask questions, is beaten and thrown into the street, and walks back in and kills everyone in it.
He meets his daughter's old acting teacher, who tells him exactly what sort of father he was.
He and the acquaintance watch the producer's house from the hills above it.
He gatecrashes a party at the house, and the security men drive him into the desert to shoot him.
He kills the men in the desert and walks back out to the road.
The producer runs to a beach house up the coast with his young girlfriend.
The two men drive north, and the acquaintance is shot dead in the assault on the beach house.
The thief corners the producer on the rocks, and the producer admits the girl died out of his own panic.
He lets the producer live, flies home, and thinks about a day at the seaside with his daughter as a small child.
nonlinear_category_reason: No timeline dominates, the scenes do not fall into two alternating bands, and no non-temporal principle groups them into blocks; the order is associative, so none of the other six shapes applies. The cutting puts a line of dialogue before, during and after the scene it belongs to, so the telling is built out of fragments in no fixed order.
syuzhet_notes: The telling cuts one conversation across three different places and times at once, and drops shots of the journey home into scenes that come before it. There is no stable present: the same exchange belongs to several moments.
fabula_notes: The chronology is recoverable from the plot mechanics - the release, the journey, the deaths - even though almost no shot sits cleanly inside a single moment.

events.content: Confinement abroad removes the father from his daughter's adolescence and lets every memory of their relationship harden without repair.
events.location: a foreign prison and the daughter's home

reader: the thief was absent through much of his daughter's life

events.content: On the west coast she enters the wealthy producer's circle, a world far from the imprisoned father she no longer expects to protect her.

reader: the daughter became close to a rich and powerful producer

events.content: Following the producer's accounts gives her dangerous knowledge, and her threat to report it converts intimacy into exposure.

record producer: the daughter intends to expose his laundering
reader: her knowledge gives the producer a motive to silence her

events.content: At the producer's panicked direction, the security chief makes a deliberate killing resemble a lone-car accident on a canyon road.
events.location: the producer's estate and a canyon road

reader: the supposed crash was a killing arranged from the producer's circle

events.content: Release brings a posted clipping about his daughter's death, and grief immediately becomes a journey to the place where she lived without him.
events.location: a prison gate, aircraft and coastal city

thief: his daughter died in a reported road crash
reader: he has crossed the ocean to challenge the official account

questions.q77_1: what motive connected the producer to the daughter's reported road death?
questions.q77_2: who actually caused the death described in the clipping?

events.content: A friend can offer only fragments, but those fragments place the producer and his businesses inside the daughter's final months.

thief: the record producer may know how his daughter died
reader: the acquaintance becomes the thief's local guide

events.content: Men at a warehouse beat him for asking questions and discard him outside; his immediate return and lethal assault announce that intimidation has failed.

reader: the thief will answer obstruction with decisive violence

events.content: The daughter's former teacher refuses the avenger's self-image and names the abandonment his prison sentence imposed on the child.

thief: his daughter experienced him as an absent father
reader: revenge cannot erase the thief's responsibility for their estrangement

events.content: From the hills, he and the acquaintance convert partial testimony into surveillance of the man protected by money and guards.

thief: the producer's movements and security can be penetrated
reader: the investigation is narrowing towards a direct encounter

questions.q77_4: what happens when the thief enters the guarded estate?

events.content: After he enters a party uninvited, guards drive him far from witnesses and prepare the execution their employer assumes will end the pursuit.
events.location: the estate and a desert road

reader: the producer's protection has shifted from warning to murder

questions.q77_5: will the security men succeed in killing him in the desert?

events.content: He survives the roadside ambush and walks back alone, leaving the producer without the force sent to erase him.

reader: the attempted execution has failed and stripped away the producer's guards

events.content: Fear replaces confidence as he drives north with his much younger girlfriend towards a second guarded property.
events.location: a coastal highway and beach house

reader: the producer now understands that the thief survived

questions.q77_3: why has the once-confident producer suddenly fled north?

events.content: He and the acquaintance follow north; gunfire kills the local ally but leaves the thief close enough to pursue the producer onto the rocks.

reader: the investigation's only local ally dies as the final pursuit begins

questions.q77_6: will the final pursuit produce a truthful account of the daughter's death?

events.content: Trapped above the sea, he admits that the daughter's threat frightened him into arranging the death later called an accident.

thief: the producer caused his daughter's death out of panic
reader: the thief finally receives the truth from its beneficiary

questions.q77_7: will the thief answer the confession by killing the producer?

events.content: He sees his own failures reflected in another frightened father, leaves without killing, and flies home through a memory of the daughter as a small child by the sea.
events.location: the rocks, an aircraft and a remembered beach

reader: recognition of his failed fatherhood interrupts the expected revenge
